dominant_strengths: Editorial serif title paired with disciplined mono labels gives the dark dashboard a confident, considered information hierarchy
KPI cards with thin gradient progress bars and consistent caption metadata read cleanly without competing with the table
Status and priority chips use restrained semantic color, keeping rows scannable while preserving the moody dark canvas
dominant_weaknesses: Tab counters, filter pills and column headers all share similar weight, flattening the secondary navigation hierarchy
Progress bars are visually identical across rows except for length—no encoding of risk, velocity, or target adds to the data
Layout is a fairly conventional SaaS tracker; nothing in structure or interaction signals a distinctive point of view
fix_priorities: Differentiate active tab vs counters with stronger contrast or underline so the filter state reads instantly
Encode more meaning in the progress bar (target marker, overdue tint) to justify its prominence
Tighten column rhythm—Priority and Status chips have inconsistent left padding causing a wobbly vertical edge
Introduce a subtle row hover/selection treatment to reward exploration and elevate the behavioral layer
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and decent visceral polish, but reflective payoff is limited because the design recites tracker conventions rather than asserting a viewpoint.
rationale.intent_fit: Solidly executes the data-table brief with legible KPIs, filters and rows, though it iterates on the genre rather than meaningfully improving it.
